title: Research 4/9: distinguishing in practice and anti-evasion norms
description: Research agenda item 4 (docs/civilizational-roadmap-brief.md:52). How narrowly can a precedent be distinguished before the practice becomes evasion? Research the real mechanics: distinguishing on material facts, restrictive distinguishing, narrowing a precedent to its facts (precedent-narrowing-to-vanishing), and the appellate and professional norms that discipline it. Then encode agent equivalents: concrete detection signals for a lineage that distinguishes its way out of every binding precedent. Output docs/precedent-research/04-distinguishing-anti-evasion.md. Web research, tagged claims, mandatory implications section.
acceptance_criteria: OWNS EXACTLY ONE FILE (create only this; touch no other file): docs/precedent-research/04-distinguishing-anti-evasion.md. Create the parent directory with mkdir -p (idempotent and race-safe: the nine research tasks run in parallel, share no file, and no bootstrap root serializes them). Do NOT create or edit docs/precedent-research/README.md - that index is owned solely by the epic join T-348 (F1 single-owner rule).

WEB RESEARCH IS REQUIRED (coordinator decision D7): at least 5 named sources, of which at least 3 are primary (a judgment with its case name and citation, a statute or code article, an official practice statement or court rule, or a named-author treatise / peer-reviewed article). Every source is listed in a final Sources section with a retrievable identifier (case name plus citation, or URL plus retrieval date). Parametric-only claims with no locatable source are tagged SPECULATION, never ESTABLISHED.

EVERY substantive claim carries exactly one tag: ESTABLISHED (attributable to a named source in the Sources section), ANALOGY (a mapping from legal doctrine onto agent mechanics - the mapping is this agent's inference, not the source's claim), or SPECULATION (neither). An untagged substantive claim is a defect and grounds for REJECT. Basis: roadmap Part V principle 5, no fabricated rigor (docs/civilizational-roadmap-brief.md:96).

MANDATORY SECTION titled exactly 'Implications for the agent harness': map each finding onto the real substrate by name - blackboard task IDs (T-xxx), the three roles (thinker, worker, verifier) plus coordinator, and the four authority tiers of coordinator decision D4 (1 operator, 2 constitutional, 3 verdicted, 4 single-agent). For each finding state which schema field, CLI subcommand, or protocol rule it demands, or state explicitly that it demands none.

MANDATORY SECTION titled exactly 'Extends, does not duplicate': for every doctrine that already has a partial implementation in this repo, cite it by file:line and say whether the finding EXTENDS the existing record or would DUPLICATE it. The candidates the scout already located: note taxonomy DECISION/DEVIATION/TRADEOFF/OPEN-QUESTION (ORCHESTRATION.md:69-77), the reopen verb with its mandatory-reasoning gate (.harness/bin/blackboard.py:470-517, ORCHESTRATION.md:58-67), the P-number ledger (state.json evolution.accepted_mutations), prose P-number citations in ORCHESTRATION.md, recontext.py append-only cited-evidence log, events.jsonl semantic event floor. Rationale: the corpus records a measured non-additive interaction where stacking one more layer that re-does existing verification REGRESSED performance (papers/agentic_harness_engineering.pdf:8, Table 3 RQ3a, '+ system_prompt only' -2.3pp; p.9 'Components interact non-additively').

MANDATORY: state at least one finding that CUTS AGAINST the roadmap brief or the coordinator decision memo where the sources support one. If the sources support none, say so explicitly and say why - a document with zero friction against its own commissioning brief is treated as unverified cheerleading.
NO CODE and NO edits under .harness/ or to PRECEDENT.md. Research tasks have no build dependencies and must create none.

Verification tier: DOC TIER per P-024 (proportional verification) - the verifier does a BRIEF replay (file exists at the exact path; every substantive claim tagged; Sources section present with the required counts; the two mandatory sections present; spot-check that 2 named sources exist), NOT a full adversarial replay. Deep evaluation of research quality happens at the synthesis tasks (T-339 / T-344) and at the epic join (T-348).
Hand off with blackboard.py handoff --to-role verifier (never self-mark done). The handoff note must name the 3 findings that most change the schema, each with the tag it carries.

MUST produce a numbered list of REGISTRY-COMPUTABLE detection signals, each with: the inputs it needs from a precedent record, the formula or threshold, the false-positive risk, and whether an on-demand CLI pass could compute it today. This list is consumed directly by T-344 and shapes the conflicts pass (T-342) and the anti-evasion section of PRECEDENT.md (T-345).

MUST specify what a precedent record has to carry for distinguishing to be possible at all: the conditions under which the precedent holds (scope conditions). Cite the one existing structural precursor the scout found - revisit_trigger on REJECTED entries in state.json evolution.pending_proposals (P-027, P-028), free text describing the condition under which a rejection should be revisited - and state that no currently-binding record declares the conditions under which it stops applying.

MUST distinguish legitimate distinguishing (material facts genuinely differ) from evasion (the material facts are restated to escape a binding rule) in terms an agent can apply mechanically, and admit plainly where only a human or an adjudicator agent can tell the difference.
MUST state the interaction with the roadmap's fork/merge caution (Part V principle 4): does forking make evasion trivial (fork, distinguish, never merge) and what would detect that.

The 3 findings that most change the schema:
1. [ANALOGY, cuts against coordinator decision D1] Scope conditions must stay a live baseline checked against future distinguishes, not a closed author-declared statement frozen at write time -- if D1's "author declares ratio at write time" is read to also freeze scope_conditions, it forecloses the mechanism that makes legitimate distinguishing possible (doc S5, S"Findings" item 1).
2. [ANALOGY, cuts against roadmap Part II deliverable 4 as literally worded] The brief's conflict-detection pass is scoped to precedent-vs-precedent contradiction; Hosie's factual-revisionism doctrine shows the sharper anti-evasion check is precedent-vs-citing-record fact-fidelity (does the distinguishing record's stated facts match the earlier contemporaneous record of the same episode) -- a different check the brief does not mention (doc S6 signal 3, S"Findings" item 2).
3. [ANALOGY, cuts against a naive detection-signal design] Raw distinguish-frequency is NOT a valid evasion signal on its own -- Re (2014) establishes narrowing/distinguishing as ordinary, universal, non-deceptive judicial practice, so a frequency-only detector would flag the healthiest, most load-bearing precedents as most suspicious (doc S6 signal 1, downgraded to informational-only for this reason).
